tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently purchased a dress online for the upcoming university gala. When the dress arrived, you noticed some issues. You need to contact the online store's customer service to report the issue and request a solution. Write an email to customer service.
bullets: Explain what you liked about your online shopping experience.
Describe the issue with the dress you received.
Suggest a resolution for the issue.
